title: A Vision for Operationalising Diversity and Inclusion in AI

bias_targets.methodology: Simulated chat interviews with AI-generated personas representing a broad range of skin tones and ethnicities to elicit inclusive system requirements and prevent ethnic bias.
Simulated chat interviews with AI-generated personas representing cisgender, transgender, and non-binary individuals to inform the design of gender-neutral algorithms and inclusive interfaces.

Simulated chat interviews with AI-generated personas possessing physical (visual, mobility, auditory impairments) and cognitive (ADHD, autism) disabilities to identify necessary accessibility features and compatibility with assistive technologies.
Simulated chat interviews with AI-generated personas spanning varying age groups, from young adults to the elderly, to ensure system features accommodate age-related characteristics.

Simulated chat interviews with AI-generated personas exhibiting specific cultural or religious attributes (e.g., wearing a hijab, non-native English speakers, varied cultural backgrounds) to assess system inclusivity and cultural sensitivity.

Simulated chat interviews with AI-generated personas from varying socio-economic backgrounds (e.g., low-income rural vs. high-income urban) and educational disparities to elicit culturally and socio-economically inclusive platform features.
